g.text: Multi-Tenant Inter-Collegiate Cricket Tournament Management & Real-Time Scoring Platform
JAVA 25 | SPRING BOOT 4.2.0 | REACT 19.1.0 | TAILWIND 4.1.7 | MYSQL 8.0
1. PRESENTATION LAYER — Web Client Tier (Single Page Application)
Runtime: Modern Web Browsers (Safari / Chrome / Firefox) | Base: Vite 6.3.5 & React 19.1.0
• College Admin Secure Token Invitation Dispatch
• Live-Scoring Operator Console: Planned / In Development
HTTPS Client Requests (Bearer JWT Token, JSON Payloads)
2. COMMUNICATION LAYER — Network, Transport & Contract Specification
Protocol: HTTPS / JSON over TLS | Stateless Request-Response Model
Axios/Fetch Wrapper • Authorization Header Injection • 401/403 Token Interception
Strict HTTP Verbs (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH) • Standardized Query Filters
Jackson ObjectMapper • Strongly-Typed DTO Payloads • Consistent Error Bodies
HTTP Servlet Request Routing to Spring Security Filter Chain
ResponseEntity Serialization to HTTP Servlet Output Stream
3. BACKEND APPLICATION LAYER — Business Logic & Domain Orchestration Tier
Runtime: OpenJDK 25 | Framework: Spring Boot 4.2.0 | Architecture: Layered Hexagonal / Domain-Driven
Spring Security 6.x • Stateless JWT • Tenant Scoping
Stateless Session Policy • CORS Registry • Public / Protected AntMatchers
Extracts Bearer Token • Validates HMAC-SHA256 Signature
Cross-Tenant Isolation: Platform Admin vs College Admin vs Team Captain
Secure password hashing • One-time invitation & refresh token hashing
HTTP Endpoint Handlers • DTO Mapping • Input Validation
Core Domain Services (@Service) • Event-Sourced Cricket Engine
• Ball-by-Ball Processing: Sequential delivery validation, striker/non-striker rotation
• Extras Calculation: WIDE, NO_BALL, BYE, LEG_BYE, PENALTY tracking & bowler charges
• Wicket & Dismissal Handler: BOWLED, CAUGHT, LBW, RUN_OUT, STUMPED, HIT_WICKET
• Innings State Machine: Overs completion, wickets limit (10), target chase & match result
• Dynamic Scorecard Aggregations: Dynamic computation of Batting/Bowling strike rates & economies
• Match-Day Playing XI Validation: Enforces 11 nominated players selected from 15-player squad
Spring Data Repository Method Calls & Derived Queries
JPA Managed Entities, DTO Projections & Optional Results
4. DATA ACCESS LAYER — Object-Relational Mapping & Schema Versioning Tier
ORM: Hibernate 6.x | Abstraction: Spring Data JPA | Migration: Flyway Core 11.x
• Dynamic JPQL & Native SQL Execution with Second-Level Caching
• Baseline Schema Integrity Verification via flyway_schema_history
• Enforces 19 Relational CHECK Constraints & Virtual Unique Indexes
SQL Statements (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) & DDL Migrations (Port 3306)
Tabular ResultSets, Auto-Generated Keys & Transaction Commits
5. DATABASE LAYER — Relational Persistence Tier (MySQL 8.0 Community Server)
Engine: InnoDB | Charset: utf8mb4 | Constraints: 42 Foreign Keys, 19 CHECK Constraints, 3 Virtual Indexes
Accounts, Tenancy, Role Scoping & Security Tokens
• teams (College affiliation, unique code, home ground)
Fixtures, Innings State & Immutable Ball Deliveries
• matches (Team A vs Team B, venue, toss, winner)
↳ Striker, non-striker, bowler, runs, dismissals, commentary
↳ Dynamic calculation base for live match scorecards
Figure 4.2: Overall System Architecture of CricArena
A 5-tier layered architecture illustrating client presentation, REST transport, Spring Boot application services with tenancy security, JPA data access, and MySQL relational persistence.
